violated_contract: An app catalog matched against OS process identities must match the processes that actually perform the behaviour, not only the app's main bundle. Electron/Chromium apps capture the microphone in helper processes with their own bundle IDs; ConferencingApps matched native call apps by exact bundle ID, so a Discord call (mic held by com.hnc.Discord.helper.Renderer) was never detected and Only-Meetings mode recorded nothing, while browsers already had prefix matching for the same reason.
canonical_prevention: Resolve a process to its catalog entry by exact ID or dotted-prefix helper ID (longest match), use that resolved ID as the identity, and pin measured helper IDs in tests. Measure catalog entries with the call-audio probe rather than assuming the main bundle holds the device.
